question: Which model was the First Five-Year Plan based on?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Harrod-Domar Model**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **First Five-Year Plan** was launched in **1951** in India and focused primarily on the **agricultural sector**.
 
• The plan was based on the **Harrod-Domar Model**, an economic growth model developed by economists **Roy Harrod** and **Evsey Domar**.
